requirements.statement: The system shall display a list of ceramic products with name, description, price, images, and stock quantity.

criteria.must: The product list shows each product's name
The product list shows each product's price
The product list shows each product's stock availability
The product list shows each product's image

requirements.statement: The system shall allow shoppers to view a single product's detail page with full description, price, images, and stock availability.

criteria.must: Selecting a product opens a detail page showing its full description
The product detail page shows the price and stock availability

requirements.statement: The system shall allow shoppers to browse products by category.

criteria.must: Selecting a category filters the displayed products to that category

requirements.statement: The system shall allow shoppers to search products by name or keyword.

criteria.must: Searching by a product name or keyword returns matching products

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a Store Administrator to create, update, and delete product listings.

criteria.must: An administrator can create a new product listing with price, description, images, category, and stock quantity
An administrator can update an existing product listing's fields
An administrator can delete a product listing
A non-administrator shopper cannot create, update, or delete a product listing

requirements.statement: The system shall prevent shoppers from adding out-of-stock products to the cart, or shall clearly indicate an item is unavailable.

criteria.must: An out-of-stock product is clearly indicated as unavailable and cannot be added to the cart

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a shopper to add a product with a chosen quantity to a shopping cart.

criteria.must: A shopper can add a product with a specified quantity to their cart

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a shopper to view cart contents including product details, quantity, unit price, subtotal per line item, and overall cart total.

criteria.must: The cart view shows each line item's product details, quantity, and unit price
The cart view shows each line item's computed subtotal
The cart view shows the overall cart total

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a shopper to update the quantity of a cart item or remove it entirely.

criteria.must: A shopper can change the quantity of an item already in the cart
A shopper can remove an item from the cart entirely

requirements.statement: The system shall persist cart contents across browser sessions for a signed-in shopper.

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper's cart contents remain after signing out and signing back in, or returning in a new session

requirements.statement: The system shall validate that requested quantities do not exceed available stock when items are added to or updated in the cart.

criteria.must: Adding a cart item with a quantity exceeding available stock is rejected with a clear message
Updating a cart item's quantity to exceed available stock is rejected with a clear message

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a shopper to proceed from the cart to a checkout flow.

criteria.must: A shopper can start checkout directly from the cart view

requirements.statement: The system shall collect shipping information from the shopper during checkout.

criteria.must: Checkout requires the shopper to provide name, address, and contact details before proceeding

requirements.statement: The system shall collect payment information and process payment for the order during checkout.

criteria.must: Checkout requires payment information and processes payment before completing the order

requirements.statement: The system shall calculate and display an order summary including item subtotal, shipping cost, taxes, and final total before confirmation.

criteria.must: The checkout order summary displays item subtotal, shipping cost, taxes, and final total before the shopper confirms

requirements.statement: The system shall create an order record upon successful checkout capturing items, quantities, prices, shipping details, and payment confirmation.

criteria.must: A successful checkout creates an order record containing the purchased items, quantities, prices, and shipping details

requirements.statement: The system shall decrement product stock quantities upon successful order placement.

criteria.must: Placing a successful order reduces the stock quantity of each purchased product by the ordered amount

requirements.statement: The system shall display an order confirmation to the shopper after a successful checkout, including an order number/reference.

criteria.must: After a successful checkout the shopper sees a confirmation screen with an order number/reference

requirements.statement: The system shall handle checkout failures gracefully, informing the shopper and preserving their cart contents.

criteria.must: A checkout failure (e.g. payment declined or insufficient stock) shows the shopper a clear error message
After a checkout failure, the shopper's cart contents remain unchanged

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a shopper to create an account and sign in.

criteria.must: A new shopper can create an account
A shopper can sign in to an existing account

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a signed-in shopper to view their past orders and order statuses.

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper can view a list of their past orders
Each past order shows its current status

requirements.statement: The system shall use a database to persist all product catalog, cart, order, and account data so it survives restarts and sessions.

criteria.must: Catalog, cart, order, and account data remain available after a service restart

requirements.statement: Stock levels and order totals shall remain consistent under concurrent purchases with no overselling of stock.

criteria.must: Two concurrent checkouts for the last unit of a product result in exactly one succeeding and stock never going negative

requirements.statement: Access to administrative catalog-management functions shall be restricted to authorized administrators.

criteria.must: Catalog-management functions are inaccessible to a shopper without the administrator role
